messages:
Lena (Design): Quick flag from usability: our dense list toggle looks cramped on laptops. vertical gap is 6px and the toggle icon feels too close to text. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/dense-toggle.png
Arjun (Frontend): I can repro. Also the focus outline disappears when you open the toggle panel. CSS maybe using overflow hidden on container.
Pri (PM): Users asked for higher density but not at the cost of keyboard or touch. Can we bump vertical padding to 10px and increase the toggle hit area?
Miko (Dev): 10px sounds reasonable. current toggle button is ~34px. a11y-bot: interactive targets must be >=44x44px. we'll add padding to reach min and keep icon size.
Lena (Design): Proposed: keep icon-only toggle visually, add sr-only text "Open details" / "Close details", and aria-expanded on the button. Also change tooltip to be aria-hidden for AT and surface full text via aria-describedby.
a11y-bot: Recommended: avoid duplicate accessible names. Use aria-describedby for supplemental tooltip text and ensure the toggle has an accessible name and aria-expanded. Hit target >=44px.
Arjun (Frontend): Quick patch:
```
.toggle-btn{padding:6px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px}
.list-item{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px}
.toggle-tooltip{aria-hidden:true}
```
I'll add unit tests and Percy screenshots.
Miko (Dev): Also saw toast stacking on dense pages where header is sticky; toasts anchored top-right overlap header when many appear. Suggest using `toast.offsetTop` token and increasing by 8px in dense theme.
Pri (PM): Non-breaking change, ship in next patch (3.2.x). No token renames; use theme alias `dense.rowGap = 10px`. Document in tokens doc.
Lena (Design): I'll update token docs with the alias and post a short rationale.
Arjun (Frontend): Opening PR with code + a11y checklist. Can someone pair on Percy review after CI?
Miko (Dev): I'll help review Percy diffs. schedule a 15m slot after CI.
Lena (Design): Thanks all! small follow-up: add a note in the component story showing the dense toggle with SR helper visible. :white_check_mark:
